_note: A tool whose own MEASURED turn cannot reach it through answerability. It will surface 0/N before a single live run is spent. This is cycle 1's work-list: each entry is closed by widening the tool's declared synonyms (DQ-T32 option (a), the shipped mechanism — batch 12 took a tool 1/5 -> 5/5 exactly this way), and the entry then LEAVES this file. A baseline that only grows stops meaning anything.

unreachable.translation_job_control: MEASURED TURN 'Cancel that job.' — ANAPHORIC BY DESIGN, and this is the ONE entry that widening a declaration must not close. Read off the evidence the ledger cites (c-tjc-jobsupplier), the real sequence is a SUPPLIER turn — 'What is the status of the translation job for this book?' — followed by 'Cancel that job.', where 'that job' refers to the id the previous turn surfaced. Testing that carry-over IS the scenario's purpose. Answerability keys on the CURRENT turn (D-R1-IS-KEYED-ON-THIS-TURN-SO-A-CONFIRMATION-TURN-LOSES-THE-TOOL), so no phrase this tool can declare will ever match a pronoun. It reached the wire by another path and was called 2/5. Giving it a phrase that matches 'Cancel that job.' would either collide with jobs_cancel or destroy the anaphora the scenario exists to measure.
unreachable.glossary_adopt_standards:
MEASURED TURN 'Set up several kinds and attributes at once for this book's ontology — I want to do it in one batch, not one at a time.' (scenarios-c-siblingpick-adopt.json). Measured 2026-08-30: the only reachable tool is glossary_propose_batch.

🔴 THIS ENTRY IS NOT A REPAIR TARGET, AND THAT IS THE POINT. D-SURFACING-IS-NECESSARY-BUT-NOT-SUFFICIENT-THE-MODEL-PICKS-THE-SIBLING rests on this exact pair: the request matches ONLY glossary_propose_batch, and the model calls adopt_standards anyway, 5/5. That adopt_standards does not match the sentence is the row's evidence. Widening it to match would erase the row's decisive case rather than fix anything.
unreachable.book_chapter_create: MEASURED TURN 'Please write a chapter. Add a new one after what I have, called The Drowned Road, ...' — the CREATE signal is a PRONOUN: 'a new one' refers to the chapter named in the preceding sentence, and answerability cannot resolve a referent. The one contiguous alternative, 'write a chapter', DOES match — and measured over 281 corpus turns it also claims THREE composition_generate turns ('Write chapter — draft the prose with the cowrite engine'). That is a WRITE tool reaching a different write's turns, which is the harmful direction: the model would create an empty chapter row where the author asked for prose. Declaring it would trade a surfacing miss for a wrong-tool hit. 2026-09-03.
unreachable.kg_project_create: MEASURED TURN 'Record that Aldric Vane and Mira Solene know each other.' — the request does not name this tool and should not: it asks to record a RELATIONSHIP, and creating the knowledge project is the PRECONDITION the model reaches by chaining, not by the request. Every contiguous candidate is either false vocabulary ('record that' — noise 3 across glossary_propose_aliases, glossary_propose_entities, kg_schema_*) or describes the edge, not the project. Reached by another path; not a declaration gap. 2026-09-03.

_grew_2026_09_03: Two entries added here (book_chapter_create, kg_project_create); two more were MIS-FILED here first and belong to the SCENARIO contract, which is a different population with different rules — the gate caught that immediately via test_a_tool_that_became_reachable_leaves_the_baseline. Each was measured against all 281 corpus turns before being admitted: two are held by the owner's DQ-T32 ruling (interposed object, pronoun object), one is anaphora the matcher cannot see by construction, and one is a tool the request legitimately does not name. The gate now excludes legacy tools rather than demanding the impossible of them.
